articles.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
articles.snippet: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

articles.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

articles.title: Why the Path to Quantum Resistance Runs Uphill for Bitcoin Wallet Makers
articles.snippet: Trezor CTO Tomáš Sušánka explains the trade-offs of Bitcoin’s leading post-quantum signature scheme.
